IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BuildDescript: Right-click to seal the fridge and start restoration. It opens after the configured powered time. Directly stored food only. Sandbox capacity: 50–1000, default 200.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_Hours: Game hours to restore one full fresh-life interval: %1
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_ObservedOnly: Directly stored food only. No credit for unloaded, offline or unverified-power intervals.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchPaused: Power paused · %1 powered game minutes left
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchLocked: The fridge cannot be opened or accessed while sealed.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchInfo: Requires %1 powered game hours. Progress pauses while unloaded or power is unverified.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchRejected: Could not start a sealed fridge batch.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchReason_u: Some contents cannot be sealed, such as containers, tainted food or fertilized eggs. Remove them and try again.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchReason_g: Food protection from an earlier session is pending. Reload the save.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchReason_l: The fridge access lock is unavailable.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchReason_s: Sealing failed. Check the fridge contents.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BatchReason_r: This batch needs recovery. Keep the save and check the log.
